headline: Earnings jump from a weak year-ago base, ease sequentially
summary_short: Chacha Food reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥0.16, up sharply from a thin ¥0.02 a year earlier but down from ¥0.30 in the prior quarter.
summary_long: EPS was ¥0.16 in Q2 FY2026, up steeply y/y from a weak ¥0.02 base a year earlier but down q/q from ¥0.30. No revenue, margin, or cash-position figures are available from verified shard data for this kpi-only pass.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Chacha Food (002557.SZ) is a Shenzhen A-share filer with no EDGAR CIK and no observed irSources; primary disclosure is via CNINFO in Chinese and the exact interim-report PDF could not be located within the WebSearch/fetch budget (a CNINFO search surfaced only the FY2025 annual report, not the H1 2026 filing).
